newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Report values Power NZ shares up to NZ$6.51.
newsitem.headline: Report values Power NZ shares up to NZ$6.51.

text.p: Power New Zealand Ltd said on Tuesday that an appraisal report by Bancorp Advisory Services Ltd valued its shares up to NZ$6.51, well below the current offers of $7.25 to $8 per share.

Barry Brill, chairman of Power NZ's independent directors, said the report "confirms the board's long-held view that Power NZ's share price continues to be driven by the competing offers from Utilicorp NZ and Mercury Energy, not by economic value".
The $6.51 figure was arrived at by applying a "change of control" multiple of 1.45 to the Optimised Deprival Value (ODV) of $4.49/share.

Brill said the Power New Zealand board was continuing to recommend that shareholders wishing to sell should sell to Utilicorp NZ, which as a cornerstone shareholder is continuing to support Power NZ's strategic direction.
